game: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut

achievements.name: Forgotten knowledge
achievements.description: Reach level 100 with an Elementalist or Umbralist (character classes).

achievements.name: Steam Lord
achievements.description: Reach level 100 with a Constructor or Phlogistoneer (character classes).

achievements.name: Just a good ole' hunter
achievements.description: Reach level 100 with a Bounty Hunter or Protector (character classes).

achievements.name: Circle Unbroken
achievements.description: Complete the "Forgotten Knowledge", "Steam Lord" and "Just a Good ole' hunter" achievements.

achievements.name: Requiem for a dream
achievements.description: Die with a level 60 or higher hardcore character.

achievements.name: Eternal Glory
achievements.description: Reach Glory level 100.

achievements.name: Glory of a legend
achievements.description: Reach Reputation level 15.

achievements.name: Specialist
achievements.description: Learn every Skill, Powerup and Mastery on a single branch of the Skill Tree with any Character Class.

achievements.name: Tower Defender
achievements.description: Finish a Tower Defense mission.

achievements.name: Viva la Resistance!
achievements.description: Finish a Resistance mission.

achievements.name: Just a sip
achievements.description: Drink lots of potions (shouldn't be that hard).

achievements.name: Treasure Hunter
achievements.description: Let's be honest here. The most important part of a game like Van Helsing is the LOOT! So go out there and gather as much as you can! From chests.

achievements.name: A good catch
achievements.description: Collect 1 million gold with any character.

achievements.name: A hunter with style
achievements.description: Equip a full collection of Set items.

achievements.name: I'm so Hardcore!
achievements.description: Finish the game with a Hardcore character.

achievements.name: Never Walk Alone
achievements.description: Finish the game playing mostly in coop.

achievements.name: Lone Wolf
achievements.description: Finish the game in single player all the way through.

achievements.name: But wait! There's more!
achievements.description: Complete a Daily Quest.

achievements.name: A change of pace
achievements.description: Finish a Scenario.

achievements.name: Tour the World
achievements.description: Play every Scenario type.

achievements.name: Perfect Plan
achievements.description: Finish a Tower Defense mission without letting any monster reach the gate.

achievements.name: Monsters' Bane
achievements.description: Killing lots of monsters will make you famous among the populace and infamous among the monsters.

achievements.name: Let loose the ghost of war
achievements.description: Let Lady Katarina kill a Boss. (Delivering the final blow is enough.)

achievements.name: Nemesis
achievements.description: Defeat Bosses to gain reputation!

achievements.name: Archhero
achievements.description: Defeat Special Enemies to gain reputation!

achievements.name: Godlike
achievements.description: Upgrade a Godlike item to its full potential.

achievements.name: In your face, Jones!
achievements.description: Collect 10 Relics for the Resistance.

achievements.name: Incredible Adventures
achievements.description: Complete all Achievements.
